baseline.label: design:lista
baseline.sql:
SELECT
        e.id,
        e.codigo,
        e.variante,
        e.original_filename AS "originalFilename",
        e.original_relative_path AS "originalRelativePath",
        e.storage_key AS "storageKey",
        e.texto_pesquisa AS "textoPesquisa",
        e.search_vector::text AS "searchVector",
        e.is_active AS "isActive",
        e.updated_at AS "updatedAt",
        e.preview_url AS "previewUrl",
        e.titulo,
        e.descricao,
        e.tema,
        e.subtemas,
        e.palavras_chave AS "palavrasChave",
        e.cores,
        e.elementos_visuais AS "elementosVisuais",
        e.ocasioes,
        e.categorias,
        e.estilo,
        e.ai_metadata->'response' AS "atributosDesign",
        e.tipo_imagem AS "tipoImagem",
        e.conteudos_imagem AS "conteudosImagem",
        e.suporte_aplicacao AS "suporteAplicacao",
        e.descricao_aplicacao AS "descricaoAplicacao",
        e.confianca_tipo_imagem AS "confiancaTipoImagem",
        e.publicos_sugeridos AS "publicosSugeridos",
        e.contextos_uso AS "contextosUso",
        e.afinidades_visuais AS "afinidadesVisuais",
        e.confianca_segmentacao AS "confiancaSegmentacao",
        COALESCE(
          e.ai_metadata->'response'->'segmentacaoBusca',
          '{"publicosSugeridos":[],"contextosUso":[],"afinidadesVisuais":[]}'::JSONB
        ) AS "segmentacaoBusca",
        e.padroes_texteis AS "padroesTexteis",
        e.confianca_padrao_textil AS "confiancaPadraoTextil",
        COALESCE(
          e.ai_metadata->'response'->'classificacaoTextil',
          '{"padroesTexteis":[]}'::JSONB
        ) AS "classificacaoTextil",
        e.processing_status AS "processingStatus",
        e.processed_at AS "processedAt",
        e.created_at AS "createdAt",
        0::DOUBLE PRECISION AS relevancia,
        NULL::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "percentualCorrespondencia",
        ARRAY[]::TEXT[] AS "termosEncontrados",
        ARRAY[]::TEXT[] AS "termosAusentes"
      FROM estampas AS e
      
      WHERE e.ai_metadata @> '{"response":{"composicaoVisual":{"distribuicao":{"estado":"IDENTIFICADO","valores":["corrido"]}}}}'::jsonb AND e.ai_metadata @> '{"response":{"linguagemVisual":{"estado":"IDENTIFICADO","valores":["aquarelado"]}}}'::jsonb AND e.is_active = TRUE AND e.processing_status = 'COMPLETED'
      ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
      LIMIT 24
      OFFSET 0

      FROM estampas AS e
      
      WHERE e.ai_metadata @> '{"response":{"composicaoVisual":{"distribuicao":{"estado":"IDENTIFICADO","valores":["corrido"]}}}}'::jsonb AND e.ai_metadata @> '{"response":{"linguagemVisual":{"estado":"IDENTIFICADO","valores":["aquarelado"]}}}'::jsonb AND e.is_active = TRUE AND e.processing_status = 'COMPLETED'

baseline.label: preferencias:lista
baseline.sql:
SELECT
        e.id,
        e.codigo,
        e.variante,
        e.original_filename AS "originalFilename",
        e.original_relative_path AS "originalRelativePath",
        e.storage_key AS "storageKey",
        e.texto_pesquisa AS "textoPesquisa",
        e.search_vector::text AS "searchVector",
        e.is_active AS "isActive",
        e.updated_at AS "updatedAt",
        e.preview_url AS "previewUrl",
        e.titulo,
        e.descricao,
        e.tema,
        e.subtemas,
        e.palavras_chave AS "palavrasChave",
        e.cores,
        e.elementos_visuais AS "elementosVisuais",
        e.ocasioes,
        e.categorias,
        e.estilo,
        e.ai_metadata->'response' AS "atributosDesign",
        e.tipo_imagem AS "tipoImagem",
        e.conteudos_imagem AS "conteudosImagem",
        e.suporte_aplicacao AS "suporteAplicacao",
        e.descricao_aplicacao AS "descricaoAplicacao",
        e.confianca_tipo_imagem AS "confiancaTipoImagem",
        e.publicos_sugeridos AS "publicosSugeridos",
        e.contextos_uso AS "contextosUso",
        e.afinidades_visuais AS "afinidadesVisuais",
        e.confianca_segmentacao AS "confiancaSegmentacao",
        COALESCE(
          e.ai_metadata->'response'->'segmentacaoBusca',
          '{"publicosSugeridos":[],"contextosUso":[],"afinidadesVisuais":[]}'::JSONB
        ) AS "segmentacaoBusca",
        e.padroes_texteis AS "padroesTexteis",
        e.confianca_padrao_textil AS "confiancaPadraoTextil",
        COALESCE(
          e.ai_metadata->'response'->'classificacaoTextil',
          '{"padroesTexteis":[]}'::JSONB
        ) AS "classificacaoTextil",
        e.processing_status AS "processingStatus",
        e.processed_at AS "processedAt",
        e.created_at AS "createdAt",
        0::DOUBLE PRECISION AS relevancia,
        aderencia.percentual AS "percentualCorrespondencia",
        array_remove(ARRAY[CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.categorias @> ARRAY[lower('botânico')]::TEXT[]), FALSE) THEN 'Categoria: botânico' ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.cores @> ARRAY['rosa']::TEXT[]), FALSE) THEN 'Cores: rosa' ELSE NULL END]::TEXT[], NULL) AS "termosEncontrados",
        array_remove(ARRAY[CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.categorias @> ARRAY[lower('botânico')]::TEXT[]), FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE 'Categoria: botânico' END,CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.cores @> ARRAY['rosa']::TEXT[]), FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE 'Cores: rosa' END]::TEXT[], NULL) AS "termosAusentes"
      FROM estampas AS e
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.categorias @> ARRAY[lower('botânico')]::TEXT[]), FALSE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.cores @> ARRAY['rosa']::TEXT[]), FALSE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 2, 1)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS percentual) AS aderencia
      WHERE e.is_active = TRUE AND e.processing_status = 'COMPLETED' AND (COALESCE((e.categorias @> ARRAY[lower('botânico')]::TEXT[]), FALSE) OR COALESCE((e.cores @> ARRAY['rosa']::TEXT[]), FALSE)) AND aderencia.percentual >= 50
      ORDER BY aderencia.percentual DESC, relevancia DESC, e.updated_at DESC, e.id DESC
      LIMIT 24
      OFFSET 0
